alex: PR #25678 — routing cache fix. Need quick eyes and merge timing. CI flaky on mac e2e, rebase window open until Tue 08:00 UTC, deploy freeze Wed 00:00 UTC. If green + approvals can we land in canary window tomorrow? cc @linda @sam
ci-bot: build status: macOS e2e failed (timeout). logs: https://ci.redwood/example/25678
sam: I'll take a quick review now, ping me if you include changelog note.
linda: I can approve once CI is green and you rebase to main. Also: is this safe for canary? any DB migration?
alex: No DB migration. Changelog: "reduce KV cache invalidation for small sequences" — small perf/regression tests. Rebased onto main in branch alex/pr-25678-rebased. Triggering rerun: /retest
ci-bot: rerun queued by alex — running macOS e2e, linux integration.
josh: (release) Heads up deploy freeze starts Wed 00:00 UTC; if you need canary, earliest slot is Tue 18:00 UTC. If you can't, we'll queue for next window.
ci-bot: macOS e2e passed ✅ all checks green.
sam: LGTM, left a small nits comment, approving now :thumbsup:
linda: Approving — looks safe. :ok_hand:
merge-bot: PR #25678 merged to main by automerge at 5372471700
alex: Thanks everyone! Will monitor canary and ping channel with rollout note.
